name: table
label: Table
description: If the content to render is a record, the table of the record

name: sys_id
label: Sys Id
description: If the content to render is a record, the sys Id of the record

name: parent_table
label: Parent Table
description: the table of the parent record

name: parent_sys_id
label: Parent Sys Id
description: the sys Id of the parent record

name: renderer_type
label: Renderer Type
description: Default is record. For typed renderers (non-record) it can be a custom string

name: params
label: Params
description: Properties passed to the component rendering the content

name: path
label: Path
description: Hierarchy support for breadcrumbs navigation. Objects in the list have the same shape as rest of the payload
